texts: Most centres perform complete repair of DORV with a subaortic VSD and RV outflow tract obstruction within the first year of life: B.
The left ventricle is tunnelled through the VSD to the aorta with a patch, and the right ventricular outflow is relieved, as in tetralogy; palliation first is seldom needed.
A subpulmonary VSD without outflow obstruction (Taussig-Bing) is treated by an arterial switch with VSD closure, often with arch repair in one stage.
A noncommitted VSD needs a complex tunnel or a single-ventricle route, not simple patch closure.
In the picture, the tunnel and the widened funnel are finished before the first birthday cake is lit.
Memory hook: tunnel and funnel before the first candle.
